description: This file implements a SOCKS proxy server and client logic, including connection handling, pattern matching for proxy rules, and event-driven communication for managing SOCKS connections within the Playwright project.

classes.name: SocksConnection
classes.description: Handles individual SOCKS protocol connection, including authentication, request parsing, and data forwarding.

classes.name: SocksProxy
classes.description: Implements a SOCKS proxy server, managing incoming connections, pattern matching, and direct socket handling.

classes.name: SocksProxyHandler
classes.description: Manages SOCKS proxy client connections, including pattern matching, socket creation, and event emission.

methods.name: _run
methods.description: Performs SOCKS protocol handshake and request parsing, then triggers connection request handling.

methods.name: _parseRequest
methods.description: Parses SOCKS request details such as command, host, and port.

methods.name: socketConnected
methods.description: Notifies that a socket has successfully connected to the target host and port.

methods.name: socketFailed
methods.description: Handles failure to connect to target host and port.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Destroys the socket with an error.

methods.name: setPattern
methods.description: Sets the pattern for proxy rule matching.

methods.name: _handleDirect
methods.description: Handles direct socket connection bypassing the proxy.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts the SOCKS proxy server listening on a specified port.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the SOCKS proxy server and all active connections.

methods.name: onSocketRequested
methods.description: Handles incoming socket request, either proxying or direct connection.

methods.name: onSocketData
methods.description: Handles incoming data from a socket.

methods.name: sendSocketData
methods.description: Sends data through a socket identified by UID.
